description: IN-LWF-KA-001 (ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21) — Karnataka Labour Welfare Fund, an ANNUAL (not monthly) contribution charged only in the state's own configured deduction month (January, flat_amount=1). employee_lwf=₹50, employer_lwf=₹100 (₹150 total) — matching the doc's own stated figures exactly. A February/March/etc. pay_date would deduct ₹0/₹0 instead — not exercised in this fixture, but see india.py's own LWF comment for that contract.
source: ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21 IN-LWF-KA-001 + §15 (Karnataka LWF, source IN-KA-LWF). Rows reproduced verbatim from hardcoded_defaults.py's own Karnataka lwf_employee_amt/lwf_employer_amt/lwf_deduct_month rows. Run through the real production engine (calculate_payroll) at authoring time.
